{{Quote|Ignar Ominaz's victory at Tasjon will keep him the top-ranked swoop racer through the racsan break, despite mounting pressure from Serji-X Arrogantus currently behind by less than two points.|HoloNet News article spotlighting [[Ignar Ominaz]], a member of Team Millennium Holos|<ref name="Holonet" />}}
The '''racsan break''' was a period of reprieve observed by the [[TransGal circuit]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] professional [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] division, that followed a [[Tasjon swoop race|race]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]].<ref name="Holonet" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> an issue of the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] reported that, after emerging victorious on Corulag, the TransGal circuit team [[Team Millennium Holos]] observed the break.<ref name="Holonet" />

==Behind the scenes==
The racsan break was mentioned in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 54|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #54'']], an [[in-universe]] [[HoloNet News (original website)|website]]<ref name="Holonet" /> published on [[May 2]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN54 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6682683|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-05-02|time=5:53 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref> [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]] wrote the site content.<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
